notes.title: The Midnight Bus will become FREE
notes.content:
Hello community!

We're thrilled to announce that starting[b] June 12, 2025[/b], The Midnight Bus will be completely free on Steam. This decision comes from our desire to let more players discover and enjoy this experience we've loved creating.

[b]Why are we going free?[/b]

• Accessibility: We want to remove all barriers so new players can discover the game.

• Future projects: If you enjoy this game, you'll love what we're working on next! This is our way of thanking you for your support

[b]A special thank you:[/b]
To everyone who purchased the game before this change: THANK YOU! You made it possible for us to imagine new stories. Your contribution was - and remains - invaluable to us.

This marks a new beginning for The Midnight Bus, and we hope more passengers will join us on this journey. See you on the road!

With gratitude,
itandfeel
